trigger.failure: INARISKPOP_2020 exportImage failed after retries even for the geometry-only-selected pilot native window of 82 x 47 cells

reason: population TIFF export is transport-unusable even at a very small native window, so equivalence cannot require a new population TIFF without circularly blocking every alternative transport

reference_operation.name: getSamples
reference_operation.point_rule: enumerate every source-native 100 m cell center selected by the same rasterio pixel-center-inside-polygon mask used by the locked Stage 1 aggregation contract

bridge_validation.purpose: validate that exact-center getSamples reproduces the already preregistered local TIFF reference method before using the same reference operation for population

promotion_rule: computeStatisticsHistograms may replace exportImage transport only if capacity proves TIFF-getSamples bridge equivalence and both capacity and population prove getSamples-computeStatistics equivalence on the same geometry-only-selected pilot
